description: This Java class 'AclEnforcer' provides algorithms for operating on an access control list (ACL) to determine permissions for authorization contexts, including methods for checking permissions, building JSON views, and mapping permissions.

classes.name: AclEnforcer
classes.description: Final class implementing the Enforcer interface, providing permission checks and JSON view building based on an ACL.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an AclEnforcer instance with a given AccessControlList.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has unrestricted permissions for a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has partial permissions for a resource (delegates to hasUnrestrictedPermissions).

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON object view of a resource if permissions are granted, otherwise returns an empty JSON object.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns IDs of subjects with specified permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with specified permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns IDs of subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: mapPermissions
methods.description: Maps policy permissions to ACL permissions of the same name.
